joule-thief: Self-oscillating circuit that amplifies rounding noise: at 1.25 us the two programs differ by 5e-15 V, at 1.5 us by 6e-7 V, at 2 us by 7e-4 V and at 3 us by 1.5 V (the oscillation starts at a slightly different moment), and they settle to the same waveform later. Not a modelling difference; it cannot match without identical floating-point rounding.
cs-varicap: Redrawn by CircuitJS 5.x with different values, so it is no longer the circuit the original recorded: the capacitance-control rail went from 4.965 V to 8.385 V and the AC source got a 1 mOhm internal resistance (ir=0.001). Compared by tests/compat_5x.rs only to check that it runs.
